evidence: Historical NASA texture maps and one saved NASA/JPL Horizons geometry record.
reading_rule: Hash check all bytes before use. Texture is a photographic prior with Lambert shading and a display RGB atmospheric transfer. No spatial spectral radiance or future weather is supplied. External raw maps stay in ignored build storage.

rights_review.basis: NASA media guidelines generally permit educational/informational use including computer graphical simulations; source pages identify NASA/GSFC credits and no separate copyright restriction on these assets. Credits retained in this manifest and the illustration record, not baked into the image.
